description: This header file defines a collection of utility functions for file operations within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes functions for checking file existence, creating links, reading file contents, directory manipulation, and system-specific file operations, among others.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path, optionally following symlinks.

methods.name: FileDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID of the file at the specified path.

methods.name: CanHardLink
methods.description: Determines if a hard link can be created between source and destination.

methods.name: Result<bool> CanRename(const std::string & source,const std::string & destination)
methods.description: Checks whether a file can be renamed from source to destination.

methods.name: FileInodeNumber
methods.description: Gets the inode number of the file at the specified path.

methods.name: AreHardLinked
methods.description: Checks if two files are hard linked to the same inode.

methods.name: CreateHardLink
methods.description: Creates a hard link to the target at the specified link path.

methods.name: CreateSymLink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link pointing to the target.

methods.name: HardLinkDirecoryContentsRecursively
methods.description: Recursively hard links the contents of a source directory to a destination directory.

methods.name: MoveDirectoryContents
methods.description: Moves all contents from source directory to destination directory.

methods.name: FileHasContent
methods.description: Checks if the specified file has any content.

methods.name: DirectoryContents
methods.description: Lists the contents of a directory.

methods.name: DirectoryContentsPaths
methods.description: Lists the full paths of contents within a directory.

methods.name: DirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: EnsureDirectoryExists
methods.description: Ensures that the directory exists, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ChangeGroup
methods.description: Changes the group ownership of a file or directory.

methods.name: CanAccess
methods.description: Checks if a certain access mode is permitted for the given path.

methods.name: bool IsDirectory(const std::string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.

methods.name: IsDirectoryEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a directory is empty.

methods.name: RecursivelyRemoveDirectory
methods.description: Removes a directory and its contents recursively.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies a file from one location to another.

methods.name: FileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a file.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Deletes a file.

methods.name: RenameFile
methods.description: Renames or moves a file.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: ReadFileContents
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file with error handling; returns a result.

methods.name: MakeFileExecutable
methods.description: Sets executable permissions on a file.

methods.name: FileModificationTime
methods.description: Gets the last modification time of a file.

methods.name: FileIsSocket
methods.description: Checks if a file is a UNIX socket.

methods.name: GetDiskUsageBytes
methods.description: Calculates disk usage of a path in bytes.

methods.name: GetDiskUsageGigabytes
methods.description: Calculates disk usage of a path in gigabytes.

methods.name: FindImage
methods.description: Searches for an image file in a given path matching certain patterns.

methods.name: AbsolutePath
methods.description: Converts a given path into an absolute path.

methods.name: CurrentDirectory
methods.description: Returns the current working directory.

methods.name: SparseFileSizes
methods.description: Retrieves sparse and disk sizes of a file.

methods.name: FindFile
methods.description: Searches for a file with the specified name in a directory.

methods.name: WalkDirectory
methods.description: Iterates over directory entries, calling a callback for each.

methods.name: WaitForFile
methods.description: Waits until a file exists or a timeout occurs (Linux-specific).

methods.name: WaitForUnixSocket
methods.description: Waits for a UNIX socket to appear (Linux-specific).

methods.name: WaitForUnixSocketListeningWithoutConnect
methods.description: Waits for a UNIX socket to listen without connecting (Linux-specific).

methods.name: EmulateAbsolutePath
methods.description: Emulates absolute path calculation considering current working directory, home directory, and symlinks.
